Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Kambli
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had read quite a few negative reviews about this place, but ended up booking a ticket anyway because I didn’t have many other options. To my surprise, the experience turned out to be genuinely pleasant.

The hall is small, but it’s clean and well maintained. Unlike most modern theatres where you enter from the front, this one has an entrance from the back, something that instantly gave me a nostalgic, old-school cinema vibe. The screen may be on the smaller side, but both the picture and sound quality were impressive.

The biggest highlight, though, was the ticket price. At just ₹90 for a 4 PM show, it’s hard to beat the value.

If you miss the charm of how movie halls used to be in the ’90s, this place is definitely worth a visit.

I'm sure the theatre is running in losses.
First of all the seating arrangement is horrible, especially in the last 2 rows. The pillars in the middle keep obstructing your view of the screen. Secondly, the seats are totally uncomfortable and keep making sounds as you rest your back on the seats. To add more, the AC installed in the last 2 rows doesn't even work properly, no proper cooling. Not a good movie watching experience.
The price of the ticket was cheap, the only positive point about watching a movie here.
The most hilarious thing to see was that the snacks, popcorn and cold drinks sold here were thrice the price paid for the movie tickets.

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsha Mhadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.
Overall, PVR Cinemas at Phoenix Marketcity Kurla offers a premium and enjoyable movie experience with great sound, visuals, ambience, and accessibility—just keep in mind the slightly expensive food.
